canvas.purpose: Main pane, panels, composer, popovers, inputs.

sidebar.purpose: Thread sidebar, one step darker than canvas.

surface.purpose: Hover fills, prompt bubble, code and tool output.

hairline-strong.purpose: Composer focus-within, input hover, scrollbar thumb, blockquote rule.

muted.purpose: Secondary text and controls at rest.

primary.purpose: The round send button; primary action as weight, not hue.

focus.purpose: Focus rings, focused input borders, selection base.

claude.purpose: Claude agent dot and brand disc. Same in both themes.

claude-fg.purpose: The Claude name as text; contrast-tuned per theme.

codex.purpose: Codex agent dot and brand disc. Same in both themes.

codex-fg.purpose: The Codex name as text; contrast-tuned per theme.

themes.strategy: Semantic CSS variables on :root (light base); dark overrides apply via [data-theme=dark], or prefers-color-scheme: dark when data-theme is unset. A pinned choice is stored in localStorage 'ai-duo:theme' and applied before first paint in index.html.
themes.darkSuffix: Frontmatter keys ending in -dark hold the dark value of the same semantic token; tokens without one (claude, codex) are identical in both themes.

headline.purpose: Empty-state question only; no display tier exists.

title.purpose: Thread title, result heading, agent names. Hierarchy by weight.

body.purpose: Agent markdown and prompt; column max 760px. Tabular numerals global.

body-ui.purpose: Sidebar rows, menu items, phase labels, excerpts.

label.purpose: Chips, buttons, form labels, top-bar status.

mono-data.purpose: Models, token/cost, tool calls, paths, diff tables.

mono-code.purpose: Fenced code blocks in agent output.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The composer (only lifted resting surface) and the jump-to-latest pill.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover fills, text colour, chevron rotation, send press.

motion.name: breathe
motion.value: opacity 0.55 to 1 and back, 1.8s ease-in-out infinite
motion.purpose: 'Đang suy nghĩ…' on a running turn with no output.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Keyboard hint shows; top-bar project name shows.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes static; model names show.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Changes panel docks at min(40vw, 560px); per-turn tokens and top-bar metadata show.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Run token total shows in top bar.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Composer control (project, mode, model); ghost until hover or open.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#55555d);font:500 12.5px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-chip:hover,.ds-chip[aria-expanded=true]{background:var(--surface,#f3f3f5);color:var(--fg,#1a1a1d)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2a63c9);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Stop Button
components.description: The only outlined button; turns danger on hover while a run is running.
components.css: .ds-stop{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e4e4e8);border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--fg,#1a1a1d);font:500 12.5px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-stop:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger,#c8322b) 50%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger,#c8322b) 8%,transparent);color:var(--danger,#c8322b)}.ds-stop:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2a63c9);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Composer
components.description: The primary action surface: rounded card with textarea, chip row and send.
components.css: .ds-composer{max-width:640px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e4e4e8);border-radius:20px;background:var(--bg,#fff);box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 1px 2px rgb(20 20 30/.05),0 10px 28px -14px rgb(20 20 30/.18));transition:border-color .15s}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--line-strong,#d1d1d7)}.ds-composer-input{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:96px;resize:none;border:0;background:transparent;padding:16px 16px 8px;color:var(--fg,#1a1a1d);font:400 14.5px/1.625 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif}.ds-composer-input::placeholder{color:var(--faint,#64646c)}.ds-composer-input:focus{outline:none}.ds-composer-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 8px 8px}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#55555d);font:500 12.5px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-chip:hover,.ds-chip[aria-expanded=true]{background:var(--surface,#f3f3f5);color:var(--fg,#1a1a1d)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2a63c9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-send{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary,#1a1a1d);color:var(--primary-fg,#fff);cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s}.ds-send:hover{opacity:.85}.ds-send:active{transform:scale(.95)}.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2a63c9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-send:disabled{background:var(--surface-2,#e9e9ec);color:var(--faint,#64646c)}

components.name: Field
components.description: Small form field in advanced options and custom paths.
components.css: .ds-field{width:240px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e4e4e8);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg,#fff);padding:6px 10px;color:var(--fg,#1a1a1d);font:400 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace;transition:border-color .15s}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--faint,#64646c);font-family:system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif}.ds-field:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong,#d1d1d7)}.ds-field:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--focus,#2a63c9)}

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: Thread row with status mark, truncated title and relative time.
components.css: .ds-side{width:248px;padding:8px;background:var(--sidebar,#f6f6f7);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}.ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#55555d);font:400 13px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-row:hover,.ds-row[aria-current=page]{background:var(--surface-2,#e9e9ec);color:var(--fg,#1a1a1d)}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2a63c9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-dot{width:8px;height:8px;margin:0 3px;border-radius:9999px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-err{background:var(--danger,#c8322b)}.ds-row-title{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-row-meta{flex-shrink:0;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint,#64646c)}.ds-running{color:var(--info,#2a63c9);font-weight:500}

components.name: Verdict Badge
components.description: Review verdict pill: green for agree/approve, amber for revise.
components.css: .ds-verdict{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:9999px;font:600 11px/1.5 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif}.ds-ok{color:var(--ok,#17803d);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok,#17803d) 10%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok,#17803d) 25%,transparent)}.ds-warn{color:var(--warn,#a35a00);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn,#a35a00) 10%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn,#a35a00) 25%,transparent)}

components.name: Turn Row
components.description: Signature unit of a run: agent dot, name in its text colour, phase, verdict, mono metadata, chevron.
components.css: .ds-turn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;max-width:720px;padding:4px 8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;transition:background-color .15s}.ds-turn:hover{background:var(--surface,#f3f3f5)}.ds-turn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2a63c9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-agent-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:9999px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-codex{background:var(--codex,#10a37f)}.ds-agent{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}.ds-codex-fg{color:var(--codex-fg,#0a7a5e)}.ds-phase{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#55555d)}.ds-verdict{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:9999px;font:600 11px/1.5 system-ui, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif}.ds-ok{color:var(--ok,#17803d);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok,#17803d) 10%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok,#17803d) 25%,transparent)}.ds-turn-meta{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--faint,#64646c);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-mono{font-family:ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace;font-size:11.5px}.ds-turn svg{transition:transform .15s}.ds-turn[aria-expanded=true] svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}

narrative.overview:
AI Duo is a quiet, native-feeling desktop tool that a single developer keeps open for hours while two coding agents work. The system is the Codex-desktop grammar, pinned by the user: neutral greys, a slightly darker sidebar, hairline borders, a rounded composer with chip controls, a round primary send, system UI type, and mono reserved for code and data. Nothing is decorative. Everything on screen is either progress, a control, or content the user asked to see.

Density is set for scanning, not for reading at a distance. Body copy runs at 14px, controls and rows at 12.5 to 13px, metadata at 11.5px, and a single conversation column (max 760px) carries the story of a run. Detail (reasoning, tool output, the diff) sits one click away behind collapsible rows with a rotating chevron, never forced open. Light and dark are both first-class and share one semantic token set; the theme follows the OS unless the user pins it.

Colour is withheld until it means something. The canvas is achromatic; hue appears only for state (running, done, error, warning, verdict) and for the two agents, Claude and Codex, who are always shown by name plus colour and never ranked visually against each other. It rejects the dashboard-of-cards and the side-by-side "versus" layout.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic greys with hairline (1px) borders; depth by tone, not by shadow.
Two agent hues of equal weight, each with a separate text variant tuned for contrast.
System UI type throughout; mono only for code, paths, models, token counts and diffs.
One primary action per view: the composer and its round send button.
Progressive disclosure: collapsed turns show a two-line excerpt; everything else expands in place.

rules.name: The Earned Hue Rule
rules.body: A pixel is chromatic only if it reports state, an agent, or a diff line. Surfaces, borders, headings and controls stay grey.

rules.name: The Name-Plus-Colour Rule
rules.body: An agent colour never appears without the agent's name beside it (turn headers, model pickers), and the two agents always get identical treatment in size, weight and position.

rules.name: The Two-Variant Rule
rules.body: Any hue used as text gets its own `-fg` variant per theme; the fill hue is never reused as text on a ground where it fails 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Machine Rule
rules.body: Mono is for text a machine produced or consumes: code, paths, models, commands, counts, diffs. Never for labels, headings or prose.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy inside the working views comes from weight (600 vs 400) and ink (ink / muted / faint), within a 11.5 to 14.5px band. Only the empty state uses a headline.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: A run is told in one column. Agents are never placed side by side, and results are not split into cards.

rules.name: The Only-The-Composer-Floats Rule
rules.body: At rest, the composer is the only lifted surface. Everything else is flat and separated by tone or hairline; shadow-pop is for things that sit above the page temporarily.

dos: **Do** route every colour through the semantic tokens so light and dark stay in lockstep; set a pinned theme on `data-theme` before first paint and leave it unset to follow the OS.
**Do** pair every agent colour with the agent's name and give Claude and Codex identical size, weight and placement.
**Do** use the `-fg` text variant (never the fill hue) whenever an agent or state colour is text.
**Do** keep detail collapsed behind a chevron row and show a one-to-two-line summary when closed.
**Do** set code, paths, models, commands, counts and diffs in mono, and everything else in the system UI face.
**Do** keep hover as a `surface` fill (`surface-raised` inside the sidebar), and focus as the 2px Focus Blue outline with 2px offset.

**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: all animation and transition collapses to near zero; motion is limited to 150 to 200ms colour, chevron and drawer transitions, the spinner, and the thinking breathe.
donts: **Don't** introduce a brand accent or tint on surfaces, borders or headings; hue is reserved for state, agents and diffs.
**Don't** place the two agents side by side or build a dashboard of cards; one column tells the run.
**Don't** add shadows to resting surfaces other than the composer.
**Don't** add filled or coloured buttons beyond the round send; Stop is outlined and turns red only on hover.
**Don't** use OpenAI or Anthropic logos or product branding; agents are identified by name and colour only.
**Don't** use mono for labels or headings, or raise working-view type above 14.5px.
